title: 5.1.5 Space Jumper — Challenge
description: Build a one-sprite platformer: arrow keys move, space jumps — but only when on the ground.

steps.title: Set up the scene
steps.instructions: Create a canvas, set world.gravity.y, add a player (dynamic) and a ground (static).
hints: Re-use the pattern from 5.1.2 Falling Block.

steps.title: Horizontal movement
steps.instructions: In update(), read kb.pressing('left') / kb.pressing('right') and set player.vel.x accordingly.
hints: kb.pressing returns true while the key is held down.
Set vel.x to 0 when neither key is pressed — or your player will coast.

steps.title: Ground-contact jump
steps.instructions: Use kb.presses(' ') (edge-triggered, fires once per tap) AND player.colliding(ground). Only then set player.vel.y = -8.
hints: kb.pressing(' ') would let the player hover forever — kb.presses(' ') fires only on the initial key-down.
colliding(ground) checks physical contact this frame.

requirements.title: Set gravity
requirements.description: Assign a positive value to world.gravity.y

requirements.title: Edge-triggered jump with kb.presses
requirements.description: Use kb.presses for the jump (not kb.pressing)

requirements.title: Set vertical velocity
requirements.description: Assign to a sprite's vel.y for the jump impulse
